lesson: The system is failing to distinguish between genuine trend reversals and liquidity sweeps, as both the short and long entries were trapped by volatility around key support/resistance levels. The reliance on low-timeframe CHoCH signals is proving insufficient against the dominant bearish HTF trend, leading to premature entries.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Wyckoff Spring or Test pattern on the 4H timeframe before validating any 15m/1h CHoCH signals to avoid liquidity traps.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC market structure shifts less on DOTUSDT until HTF volume confirms a trend change.
